Information sent through the form

This demonstration contact form asks for a name, phone number, field location, and crop details. A real operator should replace this sample text with a policy reviewed for the information it actually collects.

How information is used

Information submitted through a deployed GreatCMS form is used to reply to that enquiry. It should not be retained longer than the business needs it.

Questions

Use the contact details on this site to ask how an enquiry is handled.
